title: DO NOT USE — FRAUD
content:
SHEIN delivered my package and I never received it. I have submitted multiple requests, contacted endless “live chat” agents, and tried every possible way to get help, but I have never been able to speak to an actual human being. The chat is just useless AI responses that go in circles and never resolve anything.

I reported the missing package starting the SAME DAY it was marked as delivered. Instead of actually helping me, SHEIN kept delaying the process over and over again. Now, after all of this time, I’m being told that my claim is supposedly “not in the processing time period.” So basically, because SHEIN dragged the process out long enough, I’m now being denied help.

I am out **$120** because of this. $120 that I paid for items I NEVER RECEIVED.

What makes this even more frustrating is that there is apparently no way to call and speak to a real person. You’re completely stuck dealing with automated responses that don’t actually listen to your situation or take responsibility for anything.

I genuinely feel scammed and completely let down by this company. I gave SHEIN every opportunity to fix this, and instead I was ignored until it was convenient for them to say they couldn’t help me anymore.

Please think twice before ordering from this app. If something goes wrong with your package, don’t expect actual customer service to be there when you need it. I would never want someone else to lose $120 and go through the same experience I did.

title: SHEIN SUCKS! — But Don’t Judge!
content:
Hi guys, what everyone needs to know is that SHEIN and fast fashion in general SUCKS! Not only does SHEIN have things like child labor, but there are also these other problems! —
1. The clothes are always made of polyester for some reason! ohh, wait. I know the reason! It’s because these people don’t really care about making actually good clothes. THEY JUST WANT MONEY! Polyester is not even good, because I’ve worn a hoodie that was made of polyester and it was annoyingly hot, but these people don’t care! They only care about how much money they’re making!
2. all the clothes on this app are just things that are trendy, they’re not made to last! they’re only just a trend. The clothes might as well last as long as the trend! (which is not a long time!)
3. Even when you look for clothes that will actually last and aren’t trying to be trendy, they’re always poorly made! like, are you kidding?
— Now, here’s the problem… you may have read the title of this review and thought, “why shouldn’t I judge!?” But here’s why I wrote that. I wasn’t trying to say we shouldn’t judge this app, because we definitely should. I was trying to say that we shouldn’t judge every person who shops on SHEIN! Here’s why. You might have noticed that I’m saying all this stuff about how fast fashion is bad, but I’m also giving things from my own experience on this app, like I was trying to shop on this app?? How hypocritical am I?! Well… it’s not like I wanted to shop on this app! my parents only buy stuff online from TikTok shop, Amazon, and SHEIN for some reason! And they won’t listen to me when I tell them about how much I hate those things. I try to stay away from those things but sometimes it’s inevitable. Now, I’m not gonna spill everything about my life because I’m just a random reviewer, but I’m saying this because just because someone says they got something from SHEIN doesn’t mean they love supporting these greedy people. You don’t know someone’s entire story! But if they say something that shows they obviously know about the serious problems and don’t care about them/joke about them, that’s when you should judge!
— Thanks for reading this! Five stars so people can see this.

title: 購入できない商品が大量に表示される問題について
content:
最近、SHEINアプリでは「国内発送のみ」と表示され、購入できない商品が非常に多く表示されます。体感では商品一覧の約30％にも及び、せっかく商品を探しているのに、見つけても購入できないという状況が頻繁にあります。

購入できない商品を大量に検索結果へ表示するのは、ユーザーにとって非常に不便で、正直かなりストレスを感じます。特に、日本から利用しているユーザーに対して、購入可能な商品とそうでない商品を明確に区別できない現在の表示方法には疑問があります。

配送先が日本の場合、日本へ配送可能な商品だけを表示するフィルター機能を追加するなど、早急に改善していただきたいです。

本来なら星4つを付けたいところですが、この問題があるため、今回は星3つとさせていただきます。

普段からSHEINでよく買い物をしており、SHEINでのショッピングを本当に楽しんでいます。だからこそ、今回の状況はとても残念に感じています。これからも気持ちよく利用したいと思っていますので、ぜひ改善をお願いいたします。

title: Misleading and Frustrating
content:
Started using Shein to buy a few holiday shirts.  Firstly, the prices shown are not the prices that end up in your basket - what’s that all about?   I want to know how much something is before I choose to buy it, not double the price when it’s in my basket.  That’s really confusing.
Then I get offered a “Free Gift”.  But I have to feed a virtual puppy to get it.  Ok, I’ll give it a go… up to 98% in one day - looks good!  2 weeks later only 99.8%… the goals constantly change and the amount of food your puppy needs increases exponentially.  It seems a totally unachievable goal, is time consuming and very frustrating.  I should have just purchased the free gift in the first place and saved myself the effort. If I could find the correct price for it that is!
Don’t waste your time on this app.

title: イベントが悪質
content:
PayPayポイントがもらえます！みたいなイベントはやるだけ無駄。

20000ポイントまで目前！みたいなことを言うが、当然そんなことはない。試しに1人招待してみると、謎の小判みたいなものをゲットして、それを100個集めると20000円ゲット！と急にゲームチェンジしてくる。それで退出しようとすると、「待ってください！」と99枚までプレゼント。「後一枚！目前です！」と、これも腹立たしい。ネットをみると案の定、数十人招待しないと貰えないという難関、というか一般人には不可能なレベル。

そう上手い話がないのは重々承知ではあるが、なんか消費者を舐めてる感が見え見えですね。できるだけ招待させて、なんだこのシステムは！ってなって途中で諦めても、ユーザーは増えるからどっちにしろ嬉しい、という倫理的にやばめのシステム。気分が害されました。

みなさん、時間の無駄なのでそう言う上手い話には乗らないようにしましょう。

このメッセージにも自動的にテンプレートの謝罪の返信が来るのでしょうか。

I’ve been shopping with SHEIN for a while now, and I’ve had a great experience overall. The app is easy to navigate, with a huge variety of clothing, accessories, home items and beauty products at affordable prices. I love how frequently new styles are added, and the reviews with customer photos make it much easier to choose the right size and see what items look like in real life.

Delivery has been reliable for me, and the quality has often exceeded my expectations for the price. The app also regularly offers discounts and rewards, which makes shopping even better. Overall, SHEIN is a convenient and budget-friendly place to shop, and I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for trendy styles without spending a fortune.

title: Hit or Miss but Worth It
content: I love Shein. My favorite thing about them is their return policy.  If they did not allow easy returns I definitely would not buy from them as much. This is because, as the title says, the clothes are a hit or miss. There are minimal reviews about material and fit, & minimal pictures, just people trying to get points with bare minimum reviews. Such reviews are useless when it comes to making a decision. Their product descriptions rarely include clothing material either. So you never really know about the material & fit until you receive it & try it on. So I am grateful I am able to return things easily. I have also kept many many things bc it has turned out they are great quality & fit. Sometimes you find gems. Same above goes for shoes as well. If you can wait for the deliver time, & don't mind trying stuff on then maybe having to return it, the fits are totally worth it. Their various accessories are also pretty cool. I do wish their search bar or text for searches/product titles made a little more sense. Sometimes it is hard to search for things bc their product descriptions are so weird. But definitely overall worth it. I'm grateful it exists.

title: 日本語通じねぇ無能チャイニーズ集団👲🏻💢💦
content:
こちらでかなり買い物をしてきたが毎回毎回不良品、粗悪品が何点か混じってる。
今まではカスタマーサポートのチャット窓口で該当写真を送れば返送なしですぐに返金してもらえてたが、何度目からか急に返送が必要と言われました(毎回買う物は一緒)。
理由を訪ねても「返送してください、返送してください」の一点張りで話が通じない。話が並行線で埒が明かないとみるとチャットも一方的に切断される。
電話予約での問い合わせもあるがそちらもひどすぎて、電話に出られない時間帯を予め伝えてるにも関わらず、わざと出られない時間に非通知から一回だけかかってきてた。どこまで客をナメ腐るのかと。
顧客と企業間で問い合わせ、話し合いが出来ないのはありえないので日本の消費生活センターに問い合わせるも、あちら側からも電話が通じないとの事で結局何もしてもらえませんでした。

安さの裏には粗悪品と粗悪対応があります。安かろう悪かろうとは昔からよく言ったものだなと痛感しました。
まじでカスタマーサポートとのやり取りはｸｯｯｯｯｿ苛つくので覚悟してください。日本語通じません。電話もかけてみるとわかりますがカタコトのチャイニーズが応対します。

あとは他の人も書いてますが、アプリ内の99％オフクーポンやらお好きな商品○点プレゼント！のような誘い文句のキャンペーンは絶対にもらえません。まじで外国みたいに日本でも規制しろよこのボケ散らかしチャイニーズ企業💢🔪
SHEINの商品ばっか買ってるとガンになるよ‼️💢💦

title: Ausgezeichnete Shopping-App mit großer Auswahl
content:
ch bin mit der SHEIN-App insgesamt sehr zufrieden. Die App ist übersichtlich gestaltet und einfach zu bedienen, sodass man schnell die gewünschten Produkte findet. Besonders gefällt mir die große Auswahl an Kleidung, Schuhen, Accessoires und Artikeln für den Haushalt. Es gibt regelmäßig neue Kollektionen und attraktive Rabatte, wodurch das Einkaufen noch mehr Spaß macht.

Die Produktbeschreibungen sind in der Regel hilfreich, und die Kundenbewertungen mit Fotos erleichtern die Entscheidung bei der Auswahl der richtigen Größe oder Farbe. Meine Bestellungen wurden bisher zuverlässig geliefert, und die Qualität entsprach meistens meinen Erwartungen, besonders im Verhältnis zum günstigen Preis.

Auch der Bestellprozess ist unkompliziert und die verschiedenen Zahlungsmöglichkeiten sind praktisch. Die Sendungsverfolgung funktioniert gut, sodass man jederzeit sehen kann, wo sich das Paket befindet. Falls es einmal ein Problem gab, konnte ich den Kundenservice problemlos kontaktieren und eine Lösung finden.

Insgesamt bietet die App ein gutes Einkaufserlebnis mit einem hervorragenden Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis. Wer modische Kleidung und viele weitere Produkte zu günstigen Preisen sucht, wird hier sicherlich fündig. Ich nutze die App gerne regelmäßig und kann sie aufgrund meiner positiven Erfahrungen weiterempfehlen

title: Ultimate go-to fashion!
content:
Shein is a name in fashion that people can actually afford. They sell a lot of clothes and things at prices that are really hard to beat. The way they do business is pretty smart. They always make batches based off of current trends. Sometimes in just a few days. This means they can sell a lot of trendy clothes, accessories and more at prices that are much lower than what you would pay at a regular store.

Shein is also very good at getting things to you reliably. They usually get your order to you on time. They make it easy to send things back if you do not like them. You have 30 days to decide if you want to keep something or not. In many places you can even send something back for free the first time you do it. This makes a lot of customers happy. They keep coming back to Shein because they know they can get cool clothes without spending too much money. Shein is really good, at finding out what is trendy and selling it to you at a price, which is why a lot of people like to shop there when they want to update their wardrobe without breaking the bank. Shein is a place to go if you want to stay fashionable and not spend a lot of money.

title: Misleading discounts, confusing app and poor transparency‼️🚨
content:
SHEIN’s app feels designed to confuse and pressure customers into spending more. It is overloaded with pop_ups, countdowns, “exclusive” rewards, adverts and fake urgency, making shopping exhausting instead of simple.

The discounts feel misleading. Prices are crossed out to make it look like you are saving a huge amount, but it is often unclear whether those original prices are real or whether anyone actually pays them. The £200 credit offer is especially misleading: it looks like a simple reward, but the small print shows you have to place multiple extra orders, check in daily and keep spending money before unlocking it. That is not a straightforward £200 reward, it is a tactic to push customers into buying more.

The app is also unclear about the real final price. There are too many coupons, promotions, wallet credits and banners competing at once, so it is difficult to understand what is genuinely a discount and what is just marketing.

Product photos can also be misleading. I had to keep checking customer comments and real customer photos to see what items actually look like before buying, because the official photos often look much better, clearer or different from reality.

Shopping should feel transparent and trustworthy. Instead, SHEIN feels cluttered, manipulative and more expensive than it first appears! 🚨‼️

title: Fed up with coupon gymnastics
content:
I’ve been a SHEIN customer for years and genuinely love the range, styles and prices. I’ve found some of my favourite outfits on here, and the variety means I can buy everything from conference and work wear to holiday, party and more alternative styles.
However, I really wish SHEIN would rethink the coupon and discount system. I’d much rather see the actual price I am going to pay when I add an item to my basket even if that advertised price is slightly higher.
Too often an item appears to be a bargain, but then the final price changes dramatically depending on coupons, promotions, minimum spends and checkout conditions. It can feel frustrating when an item that looked one price effectively doubles or triples once those discounts aren’t available or don’t apply.
For the first time ever today, I have ended up placing an order with TEMU instead. Not because I preferred the clothing, but because the price I saw when I added items to my basket was the price that I paid at the checkout. There were no surprises and no complicated coupon calculations to work out.
As a customer, I’d rather see a higher, but honest price than a lower headline price that changes depending on which promotions happen to apply. Transparency builds trust,  and trust keeps customers coming back.
I still love the clothing, the choice and the ability to find styles that suit my personality.
Some of my favourite outfits have come from SHEIN and I would much rather continue to shop with you than elsewhere. Please keep the fashion but make the pricing simpler and more transparent.

title: 不良品でも返品・交換不可。
content:
おもちゃをたくさん買いました。
アクアビーズやアイロンビーズなど。

しかし、不良品が届きました。
アクアビーズは、ある色のビーズが15個ぐらい粉々に割れたのが届きました。それから、私はアクアビーズはキットのものを買いましたが、作品を作る参考の下絵に人間のデザインが多いのに、肌色のビーズが入ってなくてやばい肌の色の作品しか作れませんでした。
アイロンビーズは、プレートの針？が折れているものが届きました。

返品や交換申請をしようと思いましたが、おもちゃは全部（私が注文したものは）ダメで結局そのまま我慢しました。

しかし、確かにめちゃくちゃ安かったです。
正規品を正規の値段で買うのがアホらしくなったし、ここで買ったであろう商品がAmaz◯nで高値で売られているのを見て、だったらこっちで買う方が安いな、と思いました。

とにかくめちゃくちゃ安かったから良かった。ということで⭐︎３です。

配送は1週間ほどかかりますが、基本的に急ぎで買いたければ某ネットショップでいいかと思います!
それ以外はSHEINで十分です✨
金属製品や布製品は色々物議をされてますので、買うときは個人の判断で。それが一番だと思います。

title: Ich liebs
content:
Ich bestelle mittlerweile schon seit längerer Zeit bei SHEIN und bin jedes Mal aufs Neue positiv überrascht. Die Auswahl an Kleidung, Accessoires und Schuhen ist wirklich unglaublich groß – egal ob man etwas Elegantes, Alltagstaugliches oder die neuesten Trends sucht, man findet einfach immer etwas Passendes. Besonders beeindruckend finde ich, wie oft neue Kollektionen erscheinen und wie modern die Designs sind.
Was mich persönlich am meisten überzeugt, ist das Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis. Natürlich erwartet man bei diesen Preisen keine Luxusmarke, aber viele Artikel haben mich qualitativ wirklich überrascht. Die Stoffe fühlen sich angenehm an, die Kleidung sitzt oft besser als erwartet und die Produkte entsprechen in den meisten Fällen genau den Bildern und Beschreibungen. Mit den Bewertungen und Kundenfotos kann man außerdem sehr gut einschätzen, wie die Sachen in echt aussehen und welche Größe man wählen sollte – das macht das Einkaufen deutlich einfacher.
Auch der Bestellprozess ist super unkompliziert. Die App und die Website sind übersichtlich gestaltet, man findet schnell, was man sucht, und die vielen Filter helfen enorm dabei, gezielt nach bestimmten Styles oder Größen zu suchen. Die Lieferung war bei meinen Bestellungen meistens schneller als angegeben und alles kam ordentlich verpackt an. Besonders praktisch finde ich auch die regelmäßigen Rabattaktionen und Gutscheine, wodurch man oft richtig gute Angebote bekommt. Ein weiterer Pluspunkt ist die Vielfalt: Bei SHEIN gibt es wirklich Mode für jeden Geschmack und jede Figur. Von Basics bis hin zu ausgefallenen Trendteilen ist alles dabei. Ich habe dort schon Kleidung für den Alltag, besondere Anlässe, Sport und sogar Deko bestellt und war insgesamt sehr zufrieden. Für mich ist SHEIN eine der besten Möglichkeiten, günstig und gleichzeitig stylisch einzukaufen. Wer gerne neue Trends ausprobiert, ohne ein Vermögen auszugeben, ist dort definitiv richtig. Ich werde auf jeden Fall weiterhin dort bestellen und kann es wirklich empfehlen.

Besonders beeindruckend finde ich, wie oft neue Kollektionen erscheinen und wie modern die Designs sind.
Was mich persönlich am meisten überzeugt, ist das Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis. Natürlich erwartet man bei diesen Preisen keine Luxusmarke, aber viele Artikel haben mich qualitativ wirklich überrascht. Die Stoffe fühlen sich angenehm an, die Kleidung sitzt oft besser als erwartet und die Produkte entsprechen in den meisten Fällen genau den Bildern und Beschreibungen. Mit den Bewertungen und Kundenfotos kann man außerdem sehr gut einschätzen, wie die Sachen in echt aussehen und welche Größe man wählen sollte – das macht das Einkaufen deutlich einfacher.
Auch der Bestellprozess ist super unkompliziert. Die App und die Website sind übersichtlich gestaltet, man findet schnell, was man sucht, und die vielen Filter helfen enorm dabei, gezielt nach bestimmten Styles oder Größen zu suchen. Die Lieferung war bei meinen Bestellungen meistens schneller als angegeben und alles kam ordentlich verpackt an. Besonders praktisch finde ich auch die regelmäßigen Rabattaktionen und Gutscheine, wodurch man oft richtig gute Angebote bekommt. Ein weiterer Pluspunkt ist die Vielfalt: Bei SHEIN gibt es wirklich Mode für jeden Geschmack und jede Figur. Von Basics bis hin zu ausgefallenen Trendteilen ist alles dabei. Ich habe dort schon Kleidung für den Alltag, besondere Anlässe, Sport und sogar Deko bestellt und war insgesamt sehr zufrieden. Für mich ist SHEIN eine der besten Möglichkeiten, günstig und gleichzeitig stylisch einzukaufen. Wer gerne neue Trends ausprobiert, ohne ein Vermögen auszugeben, ist dort definitiv richtig. Ich werde auf jeden Fall weiterhin dort bestellen und kann es wirklich empfehlen.

title: SHEIN is a complete scam.
content:
placed a very large order with SHEIN, including many items, and paid for the products, processing, shipping, and customs fees. However, the packages never arrived because the postal service failed to deliver them properly. They were too incompetent to ring my doorbell or find my apartment, even though everything was correctly registered.

I repeatedly complained to the postal service and scheduled new delivery attempts, but each time I was disappointed because the packages simply did not arrive. I did not want to pick them up at the post office because I had ordered them to be delivered to my home and it was a large order. I also had no way to pick them up myself (e.g., no car), so the problem was entirely with SHEIN’s service.

SHEIN promised to handle the issue but then claimed that my address and phone number were incomplete or incorrect, which was entirely false — everything was provided correctly. They kept giving excuses and dismissing me. I had to wait multiple times for different representatives and was told my case was being processed and that I would be contacted. What they actually did offered no solution.

In the end, I was forced to cancel and return the packages, even though the conversations I had suggested I should not return them. I canceled the order anyway because the packages never arrived and I had no way to pick them up. SHEIN then withheld €60 for customs and other fees.

The €60 has just been calculated, but plus or minus it will roughly correspond to the amount I had already paid. It could be slightly higher or lower. Regardless, I end up at a loss, while SHEIN profits. For me, this is pure scam.

They have permanently lost me as a customer. Considering the rumors that they use child labor, I am actually glad this happened — if the rumors are true, I will no longer support child labor. Even if not, I still cannot recommend anyone to shop or order from SHEIN. It is easier to go directly to a store: it costs nothing, you go out, and there are no shipping fees.

Especially now, with the crisis in the East, one should think twice before ordering. I am left having paid money, plus shipping and customs fees, plus the time I spent trying to resolve the issue — almost a whole day of work — and I have nothing. SHEIN is extremely shameless. I have no packages, and they still have my money.

I really hope that this scam fails — this kind of exploitation should never succeed.

私みたいに被害者にならないためにも。

title: 洋服のデザインが最高！安い！完璧！
content:
日本の洋服って何で無地が多いんだろ？シンプルイズベスト信仰はなはだしい。ちょっと飾りがつけばあっという間に1000円単位で高くなる。総プリントのロリィタ系も好きだけどブランドのものは１着万単位でむり。

私が欲しいのは、ロックぽかったり、ロリィタや、セクシー、古着風系、アジアン系、ウェスタン風……と、個性的で可愛い、あるいは個性的で美しいものだけ。

トランプ大統領が関税とかで虐めてくるけれど、いずれは退任するので、SHEINにはこれからも素晴らしいいろんなジャンルのデザインの服を含めて、頑張ってほしい！応援します！SHEINバンザイ！

title: Down hill
content:
I’ve been shopping with SHEIN for over 10 years and used to love it, but over the past year the quality and customer service have declined significantly. It takes a lot for me to leave a negative review, but in just the last two months I’ve had four separate issues across four different orders.
First issue: My package was delivered to the wrong address — two states away. It took over a week for customer service to “investigate,” and when I was finally refunded, the amount was less than what I originally paid.
Second issue: I received an item that was completely different from what I ordered. I purchased sticky fly traps but was sent seeds instead. Again, the refund I received was less than the purchase price.
Third issue: I ordered a wedding dress that was extremely poor quality and looked nothing like the photos online. When I attempted to return it, I was provided with what appeared to be a fraudulent USPS label, making it seem like the return would never actually be received. The item is sent back and they are refusing to send a new label.
Overall, the drop in product quality and customer support has been very disappointing compared to what SHEIN used to be. I hope they address these issues, but based on my recent experiences, I’m no longer confident ordering from them.

title: 上手く買えば吉 詐欺みたいな部分もある
content:
まずは育ててにゃんこは時間の無駄だからやらないほうがいい。購入してエサとかゲットしても最後の方にはハートが全然上がらないようになる。機嫌100%(上昇値1.2倍状態)で7000gのエサをあげて3.5%しか上がらなくなる。いくら期間があってもハートが100%になって無料で商品が貰えることはない。
そして、商品。基本的に安っぽい生地。まぁ安いからいいと捉えて買い物してもいいが
単品価格安いと思ってカートに入れるとまさかのカートで金額が変わる。

そういう詐欺紛いなシステムが多数あり
最初500円でカートに入れた商品が1200円になってたりする。
2000円以下だと送料がかかる分商品単価が安いけど、2000越えると送料無料になる分商品単価が高くなったりする。
それを意識してコントロールしながらカートで出し入れするとそれなりに安く買える。

title: Kauf/okay - telefonischer Kundenservice/katastrophal
content:
Die Verkaufsplattform der App ist total unübersichtlich!!! Ständig ploppen irgendwelche nervigen Coupons auf, die Artikel sind vor lauter Werbung kaum zu finden, über Materialeigenschaften bekommt man nur sporadisch Hinweise, manchmal suche ich einfach nur meinen Warenkorb...
Beim Kauf muss man verdammt aufpassen, dass nicht zufällig ein Gutscheinabo dazwischenrutscht. Auch kommt vor dem Kauf nicht noch einmal zwingend ein Hinweis, ob man per Klarna oder PayPal bezahlt.
Die Lieferung erfolgt zuverlässig zwischen 7-14 Tagen.
Bei einer Reklamation/Rücksendung chattet man mit einem Bot, der aber Unstimmigkeiten in empfangener Mail und Posten in der App nicht erkennt. Möchte man telefonisch mit einem Mitarbeiter sprechen, sitzt man stundenlang in einer Warteschleife. Die Ansagen dort machen einen defekten Eindruck, sodass man häufig nicht einmal die automatischen Anweisungen verstehen kann. Zum Schluss erfolgt dann eine englische Absage, dass man es zu einem späteren Zeitpunkt noch einmal versuchen soll. Mein Problem bleibt also ungelöst.

title: I know you want to buy from here, but don’t!
content: I personally have been shopping from SHEIN for a couple of years now, and I usually have not had an issue. But when you do, it makes you not want to buy from the company ever again. I just recently placed an order on September 24 and it is now October 28. The last update I got was on October 4. And still no sign of my package. I have reached out to customer service via the text messaging and it is the worst and most complicated customer service platform I have ever experienced. They do not help you. I had spoken with one of them using that platform and they ended the chat before we could come to a consensus on my issue. They do not care. I did get a refund but the person I was talking to said that I would be getting a re-shipment too, and he did not issue it. And today I was talking with ANOTHER person to try to figure out what’s going on and they told me that since the refund has already been processed now they cannot even do a reshipment. They handle this so irresponsibly and nobody has an answer for anything. I think I have spoken to five or more people and Shane’s customer service and they have all given me different answer. So if you decide to order from here and you get your order, you were very lucky. But don’t expect if you have an issue. For it to be resolved how you would like. Because it will not. I’m even thankful that I got a refund because they could’ve completely just not given it to me considering the fact that they can just end the conversation whenever they feel. I 100% will never order From here again, just because of how irresponsibly they handle our situations.

title: FAST速達は信用するな
content:
最近できたFAST速達という制度。はっきり言って使えません。

title: Mit Vorsicht zu genießen
content:
Die Klamotten sind zu 80% von guter Qualität, wenn man den Preis bedenkt. Der Versand hat bei mir bis jetzt nur 1 mal versagt, aber ich habe mein Geld direkt zurück erhalten. Danach verfällt es. Also für 50€ einkaufen, ist hier nicht möglich und auch alles kaufen was man will geht nicht, weil es von ShEIn angeboten werden muss, das ist aber sehr oft nicht der Fall. Also muss man suchen suchen suchen, bis man einfach irgendwas nimmt. Also hier ist nicht alles Gold was glänzt. Die Spiele und Gewinne sind also Müll! Die Klamotten sind für die Preise, ok. Ziel ist hier, natürlich was sonst…. Man soll kaufen kaufen kaufen und lockt mit spielen und angeblichen Gutschriften.
Ich werde in Zukunft weniger kaufen und die ganzen Spiele nicht mehr nutzen. Dafür ist der Gewinn viel zu niedrig um meiner Zeit wert zu sein.

title: Missing parcel
content:
I placed an order in July for all my summer clothes for a holiday I was going on. Unfortunately my parcel did not make it to my address. I contacted customer service and I felt like I was talking to a robot and not a human. This went on for multiple weeks but heard nothing back till I sent another message. The messages I received were the same each time but just worded differently. My Shein parcel and my pretty little thing parcel were meant to arrive together. Neither of them made it to my address. I received a email to state it was delivered at number 12 but it was not. I have a photo of proof of delivery but all you can see in the photo is a random pair or somebody legs holding both parcels. I contacted Evri and explained the situation and they confirmed that my parcel was lost/stole. (I never knew a delivery driver would pass a parcel to a random person in the street.) I contacted yourselves and pretty little thing and I received my refund from pretty little thing with no issues straight away. However.. yourselves are refusing to give me a refund or even acknowledge my emails without me having to keep repeating myself asking for an outcome,so I’ve now lost out on £82 pounds of clothing which is a lot of money to a company like yourself but to me it’s a big amount. The fact you just dismissed any sort of refund or even sending the clothes again. I will not be using shein again due to this matter.
I hope that in the future  no other customers have the issue I have had, if so I hope they get a better outcome than I have had.

title: Unethical
content:
I honestly regret ever ordering from SHEIN. At first, the cheap prices and trendy styles seemed like a good deal, but the more I looked into the company, the worse it got. The quality of the clothes is terrible—thin, poorly stitched, and often completely different from the pictures online. But what really bothers me is how unethical SHEIN is as a brand.

They’ve been exposed multiple times for stealing designs from independent artists and small businesses, profiting off other people’s creativity without giving them credit or compensation. On top of that, their business model is built on fast fashion, which means massive environmental damage—tons of waste, pollution, and disposable clothing that falls apart after a few wears.

Even worse, there have been serious concerns about their labor practices, with reports of workers in unsafe conditions, making next to nothing for the insane amount of clothing SHEIN pumps out. It’s hard to feel good about a $5 shirt when it comes at such a huge ethical cost.

I’ll never buy from them again. The “cheap” prices are not worth supporting such an exploitative and destructive company.

title: Lack of customer support for non-delivered and missing packages
content:
I am a frequent shopper, however, there have been two instances when customer support did nothing to help when I received the wrong package and the other instance when the package was delivered to the wrong address. Proceed with caution would be my advice.

The first instance was when I received the wrong product. I placed a large order and it was mixed up with someone else’s order. The tracking matched what they provided online but the physical package was not what I purchased. I submitted photo evidence of the package and the wrong item itself, I submitted the return receipts from USPS for the return of the incorrect item received and SHEIN still did not provide a resolution after about a month and a half. I had to file a dispute with my bank for the items I never received.

The second instance was when my package was delivered to the wrong house. The POD that the carrier submitted clearly was not the same porch in the photos I submitted to SHEIN customer support. I received an email advising there wasn’t anything they could do and I had to reach out to the carrier. This was another large order and to say I was disappointed receiving an email with them not wanting to take accountability for a carrier they chose to work with is an understatement.

title: コスパ悪い。安全性無し。サポート残念。
content:
日本メーカーのものをコンビニ払いで買えば大丈夫と思っている人に読んで欲しいです。

話題になっているので使ってみました。
商品の質が悪いとは聞いていたのでアイリスオーヤマの商品を購入。
しかし、無在庫販売なのか、購入後にSHEINの在庫管理ミスで商品が足りず一方的なキャンセルをされました。
ここまでは中国企業だししかたないかと思いましたが、そこから返金までが酷い対応でした。

こちらは現金で払っているのにクレジットカードかPayPalでしか返金してくれません。以前、情報漏洩が問題視されていたのでクレジットカード情報の入力は躊躇しましたが、PayPalは使い道がない(Amazonやほとんどの楽天で使えない)ので、クレジットカードを入力。条件を満たすカードを4枚ほど登録し直しましたがすべてSHEIN側ではじかれてしまい、結果的にPayPalでの払い戻しを強要されました。

その処理の間のカスタマーサポートとのチャットもこちらの質問や提案は無視で、きちんとした謝罪もなく担当者もころころ変わる始末。なにも信用できないし、話が全く進みません。結局、3週間かけてPayPalでの払い戻しになりました。
しかも現金化に必要な手数料をこちらが払わなければならず、商品は届かないのにお金と情報だけ取られました。

日本メーカーのものをコンビニ払いで買えば大丈夫と思っている人は要注意です。

諸々の手間とストレス、安全性の無さを考慮すると安い商品が買えてもコスパ悪いです。
普通にAmazonや楽天の方が断然良いです。
やはり中国通販サイトは使うべきではないと思いました。

もう関わりたくないのでSHEINアカウントを削除します。

title: Horrific Delivery & Unhelpful Customer Service
content:
I’ve had a terrible experience with Shein’s delivery and customer service. My recent order was marked as delivered when it never arrived. I asked them multiple times not to refund me because I wanted the item, yet I was ignored. This happens often — it feels like no one actually reads your messages. Their responses feel AI-generated: long, overly polite scripts that sound nice but don’t address your actual problem.

Instead of trying to locate my package, they rushed to issue a refund. I’m still trying to stop that refund because I want my item, not my money back. They promise help within 24 hours, which sounds good, but in reality, they rarely solve anything. The “solution” is always the quickest, laziest one — never genuine effort to help.

Shipping is unreliable and “delivered” doesn’t mean it actually turns up. Customer service is supposed to help customers, but with Shein it feels fake and impersonal. The deals on the app can be tempting, but the delivery experience is awful and the games/promotions are frustrating — you rarely win anything without paying or inviting friends.

If Shein wants loyal customers, they need to fix their delivery process and actually listen to their customers instead of sending copy-paste responses.

title: So annoying it’s unusable
content: This app (the SHEIN site is even worse) could be OK if you’re amenable to lower quality in exchange for lower prices and can wait 3-4 weeks for fulfillment. But the endless gimmicks and fake promos that fill the screen are annoying and time-consuming. The customer can’t even check out without being bombarded by fake “deals” that are really long-term paid obligations. One can’t even empty a shopping cart! Anything that goes into the cart remains in “awaiting payment” status indefinitely. The various parts of the app (again, the site is even worse) are messy, cluttered, and slow-responding. The accounts management sections are busy, cluttered, full of irrelevant mess, and one will never not have a plethora of unwanted messages from SHEIN. Nobody needs an email box within an app just so the app owner can spam it round the clock. SHEIN doesn’t know if it wants to be a shopping site, a social media site, a games site, or all of it. The result is messy, tacky, confusing, and frustrating. I’d rather go elsewhere and have an easy, straightforward experience without an overfilled screen flashing tackiness. The customer product reviews on SHEIN are a wreck because it’s a rewards system that sees people leaving reviews unreflective of reality in the hope of getting more SHEIN rewards, and reviews of items that don’t even mention the product and are thereby useless (ex: “I love SHEIN! Five stars!” is not a product review and shouldn’t be accepted as such). There’s customer assistance, but it’s hard to find, and SHEIN calls FAQ “customer support.” This whole business and its bad tech are cringe.

Terrible customer service

content: シーンのフリマアプリには、ユーザーからいくつかの不満点が寄せられている。まず大きな問題は、出品数が全体的に少なく、欲しい商品を探してもなかなか見つからないことだ。特定のジャンルや人気アイテムに偏りがあり、幅広いニーズに応えられていない印象が強い。また、カテゴリー分けや検索機能の精度が十分ではなく、関連性の低い商品が多数表示されることが多い。結果として、目的のアイテムにたどり着くまでに余計な時間がかかり、ユーザー体験が損なわれている。さらに、通知機能の遅延や不達も頻発しており、取引相手からのメッセージや購入リクエストに気づくのが遅れるケースがある。これにより、出品者は販売機会を逃し、購入希望者もやり取りのスムーズさを欠いて不満を感じやすい。加えて、アプリ全体の操作性やレスポンスの遅さも課題だ。画面遷移が分かりにくく、タップしてからの反応が鈍い場面が多いことで、ストレスを感じるユーザーも少なくない。また、取引中のトラブルに対するサポート体制も十分とは言えず、問い合わせへの回答が遅れたり、問題解決までに長時間を要する場合がある。これにより、不安や不信感を抱くユーザーが増えている。出品者側にとっても、売上管理や配送の手続きがスムーズにいかないなど、利便性の面で改善を求める声が多い。総じて、シーンのフリマアプリは利便性、機能性、サポート体制のいずれにおいても改善の余地が大きく、安心して利用できるプラットフォームに進化するためには、出品環境の充実、検索・通知機能の向上、トラブル対応の迅速化が急務とされている。

content:
友達1名招待で10点無料と表示され、そのページに飛んだところ、演出の画面がしつこいほどに表示され、挙げ句の果てに残り0.1円のところまで来た段階で1名招待しても0.05円まで引かれるだけで0円にはならない。

画面に表示されている内容と実際の条件にかなりの乖離があり、これは詐欺ではないのかと思うほどです。
時間と労力の無駄なので他の方もやられないことをお勧めします。
また、別アプリでも個人情報流出が疑われていましたが、正直このアプリでも抜かれているのではと少し怖いです。

title: New pricing system is a joke
content: I used to shop with shein at least once a month but now I will not shop again. Around April 2025 they changed their pricing strategy. Now every item shows a ‘estimated price’ or ‘with coupon’ price. It looks at every coupon in your account and applies the coupon against every item as you’re searching and ‘favouriting’ the item. Because the coupons haven’t yet been used it treats every item as if the coupon can be applied towards it. However a lot of coupons are for example 50% off up to a max of £/$7. So when you add these items to your cart the first £/$7 is removed and the remaining items are then bumped up to their full price - not the ‘estimated/coupon’ price you saw when scrolling as the coupon is then used up. I had £88 of product in my liked items which then went up to £130 when added to the cart as the ‘coupon price’ only applied to 1 item before the coupon saving was used up. You’ve lost a customer

title: Very disappointed.
content:
I had downloaded SHEIN to shop items for vacation this summer, and added multiple items to my cart, impressed by the prices.

However, when I went to double check the items in my cart, I clicked on one of the items, and when the page opened, the price seemed reasonable, yet when I went back to the overview of all the items in my cart, the prices of almost all items had been increased by several pounds.

In fact, what was even more bizarre was when I went to checkout, I added all the prices using my personal calculator, and the checkout price shown by the system was far higher than my calculations; additionally, the promotion coupons which were meant to cut off the spendings increased it, and despite the actual price of all items being just over £200, for some reason, the app said the price was £700. Plus, the app congratulated me for a free delivery on my first order, and then on the next line, proceeded to charge be £41 as “handling fee.”

Extremely disappointed. Feels like a cheap, low class scam.

title: Puppy Keep & clothes
content:
I consider myself a pro when playing the game puppy keep. The first time was easier and I was able to pick a free item. The second time around has been harder. When I got down to the last 2 cents, the system only gave me 30 points per 100g of dog food. To put this in a better perspective, it will take me a good 90,000 points of dog food just to fill 3 cents (or one heart). I’ve had days where I’ve had almost 10g in points, and it’s only filled a 1/4 to 1/2 of a heart (depending on how far along I am). I’ve had so many moments where I thought it would be easier and less energy just to buy the dang free item, because at this rate, it is taking me days, if not an entire week just to fill one heart. And expect alot of interruptions of pop-ups.
Besides the game frustration of puppy keep, I do order their clothes more than I do in the US. From socks to all kinds of clothes, it is much cheaper than buying them at a local store. Most of their clothes are made from polyester. Be careful if you iron them. I learned the hard way that you have to keep your iron on low or the shirts will easily burn. Also, it does take anywhere from 4-6 weeks for them to arrive, but if you’re looking to save money Shein is a good alternative.

title: フォロー機能に関する提案
content:
SHEINをいつも楽しく利用しています。とても多くのレビュー写真があり、購入時の参考になるのですが、自分の体型や好みと近い方のレビューを探すのが難しく感じています。

そこで提案なのですが、レビューを投稿しているユーザーをフォローできる機能があれば非常に便利だと思います。

特に以下のような仕様を希望しています：
•	好みの服の系統や体型が自分と似ている方をフォローすることで、今後の投稿を一覧で確認できる
•	投稿者自身がレビューごとに「フォロワーに表示する／しない」を選べる（たとえば水着や下着は非表示にするなど）
•	サイズ選びや着こなしの参考として、より精度の高いレビュー体験が可能になる

また、もし可能であればユーザーの購買に貢献したと認められた場合のポイント付与などもあれば、着用画像の投稿数も増えるのではないかと思います。

ネットショッピングに不慣れな人間としては、一番のハードルは「サイズ感の不安」だと思います。この機能があることで、購買への安心感が増し、もっとSHEINでのお買い物を楽しむ方が増えるのではないかと思いました。

ご検討いただければ幸いです。

Subject: Feature Suggestion: Followable Reviewers

Hello, I’m a regular SHEIN user and truly enjoy shopping on your platform. One thing I love is the large number of review photos, which are very helpful when choosing items. However, I often find it difficult to locate reviews from people who have a similar body type or fashion taste to mine.

So, I’d like to propose a feature: the ability to follow reviewers.

Here’s how it could work:
•	Users can follow reviewers whose body types and style preferences are similar to theirs
•	Reviewers can choose which reviews are visible to their followers (for example, exclude swimwear or lingerie)
•	This would make it easier for users to consistently refer to trusted reviewers and make more confident purchases

Size uncertainty is one of the biggest concerns in online shopping. I believe this feature would enhance the user experience and encourage even more purchases on SHEIN.

Thank you very much for your time and consideration.

title: Shipping
content: Shein is a great place to get good deals, cute clothing, and better opportunities in general. However, I was not happy with the amount of time it takes to receive my package. If you’re considering purchasing a package in wants of having it ship and deliver early, you should choose between the early shipping choice which costs you extra or just buying off another website. I not only don’t know the status but the repetition of the package being through the same cycle. For example, for around 5-8 days I’ve been told “in transit, waiting for next shipping process”, something similar to this, and don’t believe it takes that long. I understand if there’s an interference with the shipping/delivering process, however I would like to know when I receive my package without being ineligible to know the status of my package. If your package still hasn’t gone through shipping yet, I’d consider just returning it and going on another website. Huge disappointment.

title: It’s an okay app…
content: I’ve had SHEIN for about 6 months now. I’ve ordered household items, toys, clothes, etc. Some of the items have had chemical smells, ripped or broken, or died quickly. Did that…then all of a sudden I need one final invite, now my invites won’t work, and my friends can’t sign up to accept it. They throw loopholes anywhere they can. “Puppy Keep” on the app lets you feed a virtual dog to get one free gift but that takes literal weeks, and they make it go slower at the last few percent (you’ll see what I’m talking about once you play it). With the coupons, you don’t really win a $100, $200, etc, they break it down to smaller coupons equaling the value ($5, $10, etc (the higher you spend, the higher the higher the coupon, but you can only use one and they only apply to a couple of items in your cart, not everything)). Sometimes the clothes are super cute, and have great quality though. In all, it’s an okay app.

title: ①詐欺広告②権利侵害放置③安かろう悪かろう④サイズ豊富
content: SHEINは多数のショップの海外越境ECアプリ。本拠地は中国。①アプリ自体もポイントや商品をゲットできるミニゲームに見せかけて、あとちょっとのところで結局友達招待しないとゲットできなかったり、そもそも元の画面に戻れず強制終了するしかなくなるといった悪質な広告がある。②権利侵害商品多数。明らかにディズニーやハリーポッターやジブリなどの作品に登場するアイテムや世界観などの模倣品が紛れている。公式品もあるが、それらに混じって模倣品がオススメに上がってくる。アクセサリーに関しても有名ブランドの人気モデルの模倣品が多数。レビューを見ると模倣品と分かってて買う人もいるようで、それがどういう影響につながるか理解していない。模倣品を扱うショップも問題だが、SHEIN自体に通報システムがなく、権利侵害を軽視・助長しているとすら言える。③詐欺広告と権利侵害については私自身がかなり注意して回避しているが、本当に残念なのは品質が価格に見合わないものが含まれること。基本的には「安いしこの値段ならしかたない」で済むが、衣類や寝具などのインテリア布製品については粗悪。服の生地が安っぽい、糸が表にはみ出て縫われている、カバンはサイズ表記より小さい、ファスナーすぐ壊れる（日本のYKKファスナーみたいな質がいいものに慣れてると不満）、など。全部が全部ではないけどかなりガチャ。面倒だけど証拠写真撮って返品！少額なら実物を返却せずに済む場合あり。④ヘアアクセサリーや小物類に関しては100円ショップ300円ショップと同じものをもっと安く買えるし、ハンドメイド材料はかなり良い。衣類ガチャもたまにものすごく良いもの引き当てることがある。海外越境ECだけあってデザインによってはサイズ展開がアジア人から中東・欧米人向けまでかなり豊富。脚の長さが違うので注意。自力で裾上げや粗悪品の手直しをする技術と寛容さがある人向け。

title: Shein Club Scam
content: I have been a Shein Club member for two years. I have never been able to use the “coupons” I receive from Shein Club. You would get the same 10%, 15%, and 20% coupons whether you pay for it or not. I have also never been able to utilize the “stackable” $4 coupons no matter how much money I spend (minimum $100 each time). I would save your dollars because it is a scam. They put caps on the coupons so no matter how much you spend you’ll only save maybe $20. Also if you purchase from a non SHEIN brand, (third party seller) the discounts do not apply to those items. I learned this a while ago, but for those who don’t know, do not waste your time on the spins and games that will supposedly allow you to win/earn discounts (another scam). I have been a customer for about eight years, and I have noticed that the coupons give smaller and smaller discounts even though they still offer the 10%-20% coupons. I recently purchased an item because it claimed it would take $30-$40 off my order… surprise it did not, even when all of my SHEIN brand items totaled to the minimum. Basically, if anything offers to give you a discount, it most likely will not unless it is one of the standard coupons. I have no issue paying the listed prices. I just do not appreciate the false advertisement of the discounts; especially when I have paid for Shein Club for years to receive them. It is extremely shady and disappointing.

title: Pricing is insane and untrustworthy
content: I’ve been using SHEIN since the pandemic. The positive is that everything I’ve ordered has showed up, and as long as you read the sizing and reviews on products, things generally fit and are OK quality. However pricing on this app is just insane, and the interface gets scammier each time I open the app. You’ll be shown one price on the product page, another much higher price in the cart, then the prices will change as you move through the checkout process and “apply coupons” to your purchase. The coupons have no predictable mathematical impact on the total cost- I’ve calculated the item prices I’m shown and the total is always noticeably higher (excluding tax and shipping). When I exited my cart in disgust, I got a whopping 30% off coupon that took about 25% off the actual cost of the order… at that point the cost per item was closer to what I was actually advertised I would pay so I just pressed order in exhaustion. Overall the experience feels scammy and untrustworthy, and I sincerely think this company is in violation of price advertising regulations in the USA. I’m strongly considering deleting this app it feels like it’s trying to rip off customers who don’t stop and do the math.

title: 運営が酷い、商品は良い、値段が店頭で買うのと大差なくなってきた
content:
この評価は星を5にした方が上に来ると聞いたので仕方なく星5ですが酷評です。

かなり前からSHEINで服を買っています。 商品自体はレビューをきちんと見ていればとても良いものばかりでその点に関しては重宝しています。 しかし最近TikTokや広告でよく見る招待すると無料で何か貰えるようなイベントはひとつ残らず全て詐欺です。 まぁ最初から期待はしていませんがダメ元でやってみると最悪でした。 報酬まで残り1というところで招待をするも画面には表示されていない0.9という数字が現れ、その後どれだけ招待しても報酬は一回も貰えませんでした。 その後1度だけチャットサポートを使い問い合わせてみましたが曖昧かつ意味不明な説明をひたすら長文で送られ、解決していないのに解決済に一方的にされました。 また私の友人にもこのゲームを行った人がいましたが0.9という存在しない数字から全て全く同じ状況になりそのまま制限時間が来たそうです。 最近ではショッピングモールなどの専門店で買う服と値段も余り変わらなくなってきており、サービスも運営も今まで利用したどんなアプリよりも酷いので私は全くおすすめ出来ません。 私もこれを機にアプリを消そうと思いました。

content:

梱包・製造・保管のどの過程で入っててもおかしくない。中国に工場がある会社なんて、ざらにあるのに、なんでここの商品は発がん性物質が大量に出るのか教えて欲しい。報道では、下着にも基準値を超えて大量に検出されたって、怖すぎて買った服も収納用品も全部捨てた。
家族と猫と住んでて皆の身体が心配だから、安心出来ないし、結局全部捨てた。

title: 先ほど退会できました。
content:
一度買い物をすると本人確認が必要なようです。
最初は自分でメールでの退会手続きをしようと思いましたが、うまくできず次にカスタマーサポートの問い合わせをしましたが24時間以内の返信とあり直ぐに退会したいなと思ったので、最終的にはカスタマーサポートの対人チャットで直ぐに退会できました。
本人確認のために支払い済みの注文詳細がわかるスクショが必要でした。
最初はスクショの貼り方がわかりませんでしたが、書き込み欄に何も書かずに右の㊉のボタンを押せば画像またはファイルのどちらかを貼り付けるための選択肢が出てくるのでそこから貼り付けに進めました。

チャットにて最初に送られてきた文章が少し誤字がありましたが、やり取りのタイムラグの少なさ的に日本の方に対応されたと思います。
また、この書き込みをしようとした時、アプリのアップデートが表示されていたので自分で退会できなかったのは、アップデートしていなかったからかもしれません。

content:
SHENを利用してしばらくが経ち二つのことが実感されました。
１つ目は、写真詐欺が本当に多い
２つ目は、輸送トラブルも本当に多い
ということです。

【写真詐欺について】
写真詐欺というのも、色が全く違う、商品が全くの別物、届いた服の素材が写真とは異なり凄くボロボロだった等が主に挙げられます。

これは佐川急便ではなく、ヤマト郵便のみでの最近多く見られるのですが、配送されずに返品されてしまう事が本当に多いんです。
そのためお金だけ取られてしまうという事が沢山見られます。

きちんと配送され望み通りの品が届いたらもう神が味方にすごくつかれているのでもう精一杯感謝をした方がいいレベルです。
御自身の自己責任ですので、なにがあってもどうしても注文したい等のお気持ちがあられるのならば注文をおすすめします。

title: Poor delivery service
content:
It really pains me to write a negative review of shein. I have been a loyal customer for several years. I love the jewelry and I will miss it. Now that I want to delete my account shein is saying they can't delete it at this time. I don't owe any money to this company. Unless my package mysteriously arrives or FedEx informs me that there were 2 packages, I'm done.  Crappy way to treat loyal customers.

title: Comparing SHEIN to Temu
content:
This app is genuinely so much better than it’s orange twin, Temu. Both apps have the exact same products for the same price. Temu is more known for free items but you can get free items on SHEIN too. Both apps have games. SHEIN on the other hands has never let me down. My items always ship at least a day early, even when it said there was a delay and it was gonna be late it arrived exactly on time. Also. Everything I get from SHEIN lasts me a while and is amazing quality. Yeah there are a few things here and there that aren’t good but for the most part everything works amazingly. I’ve bought clothes, LED lights, phone cases, earbuds, and more. Everything has been amazing quality. Even if something breaks it’s probably still possible for the item to work as originally intended. Like phone cases for example, I’ve had a few break but it’s always been the handle thing for the back of the phone. Some are used only for holding the phone while others are used as a kickstand. Either way even if it breaks off it still protects the phone. I had a phone case for almost a year and I never have cases for that long. I constantly drop my phone on hard surfaces like concrete and my phone is perfectly fine. It took months for my last case to start falling apart and when I did it took me a month to finally get a new case even though I didn’t entirely need a new one.
Anyways, SHEIN is exactly all I could hope for and is such an amazing app especially compared to Temu where I get low quality stuff and slow shipping. My mother once got something that was 5 days late. Very disappointing. Never had that issue with SHEIN though!

title: 届くのがめっちゃ遅い
content:
SHEIN使い初めて半年程経ちました。
VIP3の最高ランクに行くくらい買い物したのでちゃんとレビュー書きます。

まず、商品ですが、安いものは基本ペラペラの生地だと思っていいです。(SHEINにしては)高いと思うものはやっと普通くらい。

次に商品購入者のレビューですが、まぁ、あまりアテには出来ないです。皆さんポイント欲しさに使う前にレビューされる方が多いので、使用感や自分の欲しい状況がないなど、よくあります。
上から下までしっかり読めばちゃんとレビューしてる人はいると思います。
半信半疑くらいで考えた方がいいかも。

次に決済ですが、色々な決済方法があり、多彩で助かってます。コンビニやPayPayなど色々あります。
購入する際は基本的にいつもクーポンが配布されているのでその条件に合うように商品を選びましょう。
私はいつもクーポンに助けられてます。

決済が終わればあとは届くの待ちですが、基本的に早くても5~6日は待たされます。
時期が悪いと1週間以上や、お届け予定日より遅く到着します。
お届け予定日には届かないって気持ちで待つのがいいかも知れないです。
せっかちさんには向いてないと思います。

総合的に見て、生地の薄さと届くのがめっちゃ遅いの以外はいいアプリだと思います。

title: イベントは詐欺まがい
content:
品数は多く、楽天やAmazonなどの他サイトより少し安く買えます。100均で売っているものは、そちらの方が安いことが多いです。

【イベントについて】
商品が無料でもらえると見せかけて、条件達成のために時間を使わせた挙句、友だちを紹介しないと商品は貰えないと言うオチ。

【ざっくりとした内容】
先日、アプリを開いたところいきなりイベントが始まり、ルーレットで当たった点数を無料でプレゼントと言うものでした。ルーレットは10点無料１０分以内に選ぶと言う制限時間付き、１０分で選び切れずにいるとボーナス２０分追加となり何とか10点選び住所を確認。すると、無料になる金額のルーレットが出現。最初の無料になるてんすを決めるルーレットは何だったのか🫤10点の総額には少し足りない金額が当たり、足りない分はSNSに投稿して稼がないといけない。“最大1投稿1円”というよくわからない表記。いくつかSNSに投稿したが一向に残りの1円は消えず…

ルールには長ーい説明が載っているようでしたが、制限時間を課せられている状態で全て把握する人がいるのでしょうか。

全くもって不公平条件だと思いました。
今まで信頼していただけに残念です。
詐欺サイトまがいなことを始めて、質が落ちたようです。

title: I love shein !!!
content: I love the good quality of items and the low prices, you get your money’s worth and there is pretty much something on there for everyone. Although the background of shein isnt to great i would still highly recommend it . I have only ever had to return something twice and one was an ipad case but that was my fault because i selected the wrong size and the other was a pack of three tops which were just the wrong size . Always look at the size guide when looking for clothes because you might be one size in a certain brand but it wont always be the same measurements on shein so check the size guide and that will help you . Also look at the reviews of it , I mainly go to the reviews to see if it is true to its size and to see pictures people have put on to see what things are really like because once i bought a pack of mini claw clips and i thought they would be a good size for a half up half down hairstyle hut they were only 2cm long but when i looked at the reviews afyer they were delivered i realised if i had looked at the reviews that that wouldn’t have happened . So the reviews are really good for seeing what you are actually going to get because some things are advertised to look a bit better then they are .The shipping however is not free but £2 GBP this isn’t that much but when it was my first order I didn’t know that so i had to take things out of my cart and it takes normally 9-14 days , for me it always seems to come between 9-11 days but sometimes it will take less than 9 days , you can also get express shipping which is a little bit more money but if you need something soon then it wouldnt be a bad purchase. Overall shein is one of my favourite places to buy thing from since everything is good quality and good prices . I VERY VERY VERY VERY HIGHLY RECOMMEND !!!!! I hope my review helped .

title: プロモーションがしつこい
content:
S3ランクのヘビーユーザーですが通知をオフにしていてもアプリを開くとプロモーションの通知が頻繁に出ます。現在お気に入りにも登録していないしカートにも入っていない商品を「残り僅か！お急ぎ下さい！」と購入を急かしてきます。
タップしたところでカートに何も入ってないので空のカート画面に飛ばされるだけです。

最近ずっと出てくる在庫少のお知らせは過去にカートに入れて実際買った物ですが、届いて実物を見て写真と違い過ぎたので返品した物です。これに限らず一部の過去にカートに入れた事のある物は情報を追跡されこのように在庫が少なくなるとオフにしていようがアプリを開くとお知らせが届きます。

実際お気に入りに入れていて通知をオンにしているなら分かりますがオフにしている上に一ミリも関心のない物を何度も見せられて迷惑だし正直凄く萎えます。
通知オフにしていたらお知らせが来ないようにするだけで解決すると思うのですが何度報告しても担当部署とやらはこの仕様を直す気は全く無いようで本当に残念です。

title: 受け取り方次第かな？

title: Overrated… with huge flaws.
content:
I hate, HATE this app. My enemy. Let’s say, some of the clothes on here are very nice indeed… but, hmm… this is a bad app with horrible secrets.

Right you’ve probably heard about this, but apparently children undergo forced labour (or, whatever else, but it’s something like this). This is very unethical, unhealthy.

Also, they’re a great partner with the fast fashion industry. Polluter to the environment, and even nasty to our own species. And you may have noticed they only use plastic re-sealant bags (which are useful, but concerning). I’m not entirely sure about the bag packaging, but, I will assume it’s harmful.

Another horrible polluter with this app would be synthetics (polyester, specifically). Which is harmful to us humans, our beautiful Earth, wildlife, water… everything. It’s good they stick with cotton (ahem, sometimes) but that doesn’t make it more eco. Source it organically (cotton) and just at a higher price, that’s what I can call amazing.

100% give this app a skip. Come on. I’m sure there are other flaws (but cannot think of right now), so… you know what to do. Research yourself, and discover their… horrific problems…
So, yeah, don’t have it. It may be good value but… it’s just not worth it. Find another shopping app that’s ethical and eco friendly. 😒😡👎

title: 特典BIGゲームは時間の無駄
content:
特典BIGゲームで無料ギフトなどが貰えるゲームがあります。
ルーレットが回って誰でも5点の内4点は無料になります。
ここで罠が。
"残り1円で全て無料"になり、
誰かに紹介リンクから入ってもらうと、
残りの1円が無くなり、無料で貰える。
ただ、その1円から残り0.6円・・0.4円と刻まれていきます。
紹介で利用者を増やしたいのはわかるが、
やっている事は詐欺。
残り1円なら一人に紹介すれば、ノルマ達成でしょ？
日本には0.6円なんて通貨は存在しない。

そもそも欲しい物を選んだ後にこの事実が出る。
最初から分かっていれば参加などしない。
"〇人紹介すれば〇〇円分のクーポンが貰える"など最初から説明していて欲しい。

散々時間を掛けて欲しい物を選び、
結局貰えない。
裏切られた気分です。
時間を返して欲しい。

title: 悪い意味で⭐︎５つ
content:
いつもここも含めてネットでクレカで買い物する時は、
クレカ番号をマイページ等に登録せずにいちいち手入力で番号を打って、
「次回の買い物でもこのカードを使う」的な項目もチェックを外して買い物しているのにも関わらず、
マイページの支払い方法の所を見たら勝手にクレカの番号が登録されてて怖くなってアカウント削除の要請をしてアンスコしました
他の方のレビューを見ても思う、個人情報をなんだと思ってるんだろう
そしてあと、私もHELPと書かれたタグを見ました…悲しいですね
ここは労働者も客も大事にしない所だと思う
衣類は一回洗濯したらすぐに毛玉がついてもう着られないので、結果的にコスパ最悪です
伸びきったニットが届いた事もありました
化粧品もほとんど中身のないマスカラだったり、肌につかないラメシャドウだったり、カッサカサのマットリップとか、100円ショップ以下の質で、肌に悪そうで怖い
色々買ってみたけど、結局2回目3回目って気に入って使ったものは何ひとつなかった
日本は物価高だけど、安く買っても結局使い続けられなかったらそれはお金をドブに捨ててる事と同じなので、
もう二度とここで買い物をする事はないです
やっぱり国産に回帰しようと思います

title: いまだに信用できない
content:
以前、このアプリは起動時にスマホのクリップボード情報（コピー、切り取りした情報）を盗み取る仕様となっていました。

購入にはまったく必要のない情報で、何の目的があってスパイ行為をしていたのか分かりませんが、とても気持ち悪いですね。企業として悪質です。

【その他 問題点】

過去にはSHEINの服に基準値の20倍ほどの鉛が含まれていた事が問題となりました(カナダ保健省公表)

イギリスのテレビ局が商品を供給する工場に潜入取材しており、劣悪な労働環境問題が取り上げられていました。 これはスイスの人権団体の調査でも明らかになっています。

ドイツの研究所の調査では、SHEINの服には中国の新疆ウイグル自治区で生産された新疆綿が使われていることが判明しています。

新疆綿は強制労働で作られた疑いがあるなどの理由から、海外ブランドや国内の大手アパレル企業では使用をやめる動きがあります。

最後に、購入される方は「 SHEIN 虫 」で検索してから購入する事をおすすめします。衛生面でも不安だらけで心配です。

title: Great overall shopping experience
content: I’d had Temu on my phone for a while, and loved looking at all the different products. But  I never ordered anything because honestly the site felt a little too… not translated well? Not polished is what I’m thinking. But my coworker had on a cute blouse and she said she got it from SHEIN. I’d always seen the ads for it, but they always had these little skinny models and it looked expensive. My coworker and I are plus sized, so I downloaded the app…. then PROMPTLY LOST MY MIND!!! 🤣 I have placed many orders from it. The clothes are fantastic quality and really low prices. I’ve bought sterling silver jewelry from it and couldn’t believe how well made it was. I recently started Diamond painting and they have every kind of style imaginable, plus any kind of tool you could ever want. I bought a cat drinking fountain from there, actually 2. The first one died within a couple days but it was $4 so i couldn’t be mad. Bought a different one and my cat absolutely loves it. Bought shoes from there and they fit perfectly. I’ve run across one or two things from there that weren’t the best quality, but I’d only spent a few dollars so again I couldn’t be mad. My only major gripe with them is one of the shipping companies they use. Majority is USPS which you can track; a couple came from OnTrac which I’d never heard of, but no complaints. The one that’s a pain is SpeedX, they are the worst. They left a package outside my door in the rain when they could have put it in between my screen door and front door, so it was stolen. But I contacted SHEIN customer service and they refunded the whole order! So great customer service s as well. Honestly a great app and very well done.

title: Absolutely love SHEIN!!
content: As a high school senior navigating the delicate balancing act of saving up for college while aspiring to build a more sophisticated and adult-like wardrobe, SHEIN has been nothing short of my fashion savior. The allure lies in its vast repertoire of styles, an expansive playground where I can explore and experiment, all without emptying my piggy bank. It's a journey of self-discovery through clothing, and here's why I adore SHEIN. The sheer diversity of styles they offer is like a treasure trove waiting to be explored. It's not merely a store; it's a canvas where I can paint my fashion identity, and it doesn't cost me an arm and a leg. I have a soft spot for all the pieces I've acquired from SHEIN. Granted, some of my friends have faced hiccups with their purchases - issues that are par for the course with online shopping and the intricacies of shipping. However, SHEIN's customer service has consistently come to the rescue, ensuring that they either receive the correct item or a swift replacement. Now, I've heard murmurs about concerns regarding the quality of SHEIN's garments. But let's be real, folks - when you're snagging those popular, cute, and trend-setting pieces at such affordable prices, it's unrealistic to expect the world's finest fabrics. We have to set our expectations right. If a $5 shirt happens to be a tad fragile or feels slightly unconventional, that's just the nature of budget-friendly fashion. It's like comparing apples and oranges. If you desire a $50 shirt for what's termed as "better quality," you might be in for a surprise because, more often than not, it's the same song, different verse.

title: Shopping and gaming
content: So far hopping experience is fine.   Don’t bother playing games.  You will only help Shein get new people joining Shein, but Shein will cheat when you are close to win the prize.  Playing sponsored games is like working for Shein, right.  You invite people and for them to accept your invitation they need to download Shein app and creating their account.  You basically get rewarded by successfully referring Shein to the new people. I was only .02 diamonds to win $200. title: Not the devil they’re made out to be.
content: Honestly, I avoided Shein for a long time bc of all the bad publicity the media likes to give them. I finally decided to check it out myself and I have been incredibly pleased with their products and services. There are a variety of price ranges and depending on where you land on that spectrum, you get what you pay for but even their $5 clothing pieces are not bad. This isn’t just a store for teenagers or “uninformed” young people. Shein has a diverse range of customers from all different ages and stages in life. title: 安かろう悪かろう
content:
子供たちのチームで一人一人に持たせるために、同じ商品をチームの人数分を複数個数注文したら、1個不足していたことがあった。

日本のECサイトで買い直した。
貴社が日本人の価値観には合わない対応は想定内だったけど、
もう二度と利用しない。
悲しい。

content: I think SHEIN is a very good app and the products are amazing quality and shipping is very fast. It is two pound for normal shipping/to convenience store and nine pound for express shipping. title: Affordable Fashion- if you know where to look!
content: SHEIN is a good affordable fashion company plus much more but I cannot stress enough that you have to read the details! Check sizes, (not just on clothing) it’s very important to actually read the exact measurements. Even though you may be a certain size normally you may need to size up or down, the measurements are different for each article of clothing. Look at the description for the materials, it will help you decide the quality and how the clothing will hold up. Read the reviews, look at the pics! It will help depict quality, sizing, and what it would really look like on you. If you follow these suggestions I think you will be pleasantly surprised at what you can find. I’ve been shopping on SHEIN for over a year now and I made mistakes in the beginning and ended up with a pile of clothes I’ll never wear but now SHEIN is the first place I check if I need something. It’s not just great for clothing, I’ve purchased hair accessories, household necessities, home decor, and more. You can’t beat the prices and their shipping time has greatly improved!

title: Ich bin süchtig!
content:
Anfangs war ich, wie so viele auch, skeptisch. Diese Preise- kann man da Qualität erwarten? Ich habe es ausprobiert und mittlerweile kann ich nach weiteren zahlreichen Bestellungen bei SHEIN behaupten, die Qualität ist für diese Preise wirklich erstaunlich gut!

Sauber verarbeitete Nähte, vor allem gerade. Die Stoffe sind je nach Kleidungsstück schön fließend und feminin. Leicht. Im Sommer habe ich wie verrückt Kleider und Tops bestellt, und auch mit Bikinis oder Unterwäsche habe ich nur positive Erfahrungen gemacht. Das Tolle ist, SHEIN hat wie kein anderer, die ausgefallensten und tollsten Kleidungsstücke! Da können H&M und Co. lang nicht mithalten!

Die Bestellung ist einfach, man bekommt regelmäßig Coupons und Punkte, die sich nochmal günstig auf den Endpreis auswirken. Kauf auf Rechnung ist wirklich entspannend, so kann man ausprobieren und einen Teil zurück schicken, ohne direkt den vollen Betrag vorleisten zu müssen. Die Rückabwicklung geht so schnell, dass letztendlich nur noch die Differenz eingezogen wird, bzw. überweisen muss.

title: It’s majority of my closet & boosted my confidence ✨
content: I know people think it’s wrong to shop with a retailer such Shein because it’s technically or allegedly fast fashion, but it’s really not all that you think or especially expect. First of all, you have to read through the reviews! Not only does it help to find if it’ll be right for you (trust me), but everyone does it because it earns you points. Which is what leads me into my main point (sorry, got side tracked), this store/app has helped me be able to achieve how I’ve always wanted to without having to break my budget. No matter how hard I work and save, I still can’t seem to afford the nicer or “non-fast fashion” brands (which, let’s face it, there’s really no such thing, if we’re being real). But Shein’s clothing has helped me be able to finally dress how I want, in the style I’ve always wanted to create - and still be able to afford it (instead of just going without it, dressing boring/with the same old clothes I’ve had for years. but hey? at least I can pay just all my bills & that’s it 👍🏼🥴). My point is, Shein gave me my confidence back and also the boost I needed with confidence as well as courage to dress how I want, when and wherever I want - even if that means being overdressed 💋

title: HORRIBLE SHOPPING APP
content:
Please read. For all of the 5 star reviews that make shein look legit. It is not. It’s a horrible shopping app. At first shein was cool, I got all my things I ordered and received fine. The app makes it look like the clothes you get are cheap and comfortable, but most of them are cool designs that don’t last for long depending on how much you wash it. Materials you receive are either itchy, sheer, thin, or too thick. If you do receive a good materiales something, you will find that 1 or more things are a complaint. The order I paid for, was for 4 items, a hoodie, phone case, necklace, and a pair of socks. Doesn’t seem like a big deal, right? I ordered this on Sep. 21st and the tracking feature said it would come in on Oct. 3-6. I expected my order to come in a few days late. After a week and a half I was starting to get tired of looking out for it. A few days after I ordered it, the hoodie I bought said it was out of stock. I didn’t think I wouldn’t get it. I thought I ordered it before it got sold out. I messaged them about it and ‘Joe’ tried to help me. I told him my problem and said he would contact me back. I have not yet received the message. I keep looking to see if I had any notifications. And saw that I did. It said that the hoodie I bought, just got refunded. Me nor my family did this. So I got really mad. Not only did I not receive the  4 things I bought, I will only be getting the 3. The main complaint that I am making, is that It took shein almost a whole month (26ish days) to not tell me there was a problem with my order, but took them 5 minutes to tell me I’m not getting my item.

So disappointed in Shein and will not be buying again. Way to go..

1st, the good bits.  Deals aplenty, variety is insane (home stuff, jewelry, pets, accessories, even things for laundry, etc ad nauseam), I couldn’t possibly look at everything.  That’s very convenient in a 1 stop shop.  Get it at the right time and you got deals. And SHEIN has a points reward system, which is a decent way to get a few bucks off your order, or free shipping (that of which is also easy to get on their live broadcasts, free shipping codes).

2nd, the downers. Polyester POLYester POLYESTER! The photos of their products are really quite lovely, but I find I spend a lot of time looking at details of a garment more than the price or sizing.  If it’s 100% polyester, NO.  Especially if it’s not a discounted item.  My first several orders, EVERYTHING was 100% polyester; I got wise quick.  I am a plus size, and I find myself pining over some of their collabs that is not past size 12.  If you are a plus size he/she/they, you may experience this.  That’s not to say they don’t have ample clothes in Plus, THEY DO! The Polyester cheap fabric, it turns me off to Goodwill rather than SHEIN.

In all honesty I will still buy from SHEIN.  1 star off for the fabric.  Speed of delivery is excellent.  And why do I love those little baggies stuff is packed in?! LOL Thanks SHEIN.

title: 向き不向きはある
content:
結論から言うと個人的にはめっちゃいいし、3回購入したけど全部大きな破損もなく届いた。
だけど友達が中身が空で袋だけ届いたってイン○タのストーリーで言ってた。(その後の対応は不明)

発送は早いけど、空飛んで運ばれてくるから速達みたいな感じで書いてあっても10日前後かかる印象。
壊れやすい物買う人は布製品と一緒に買うと無事に届きやすいらしい。
海外から来るのに2000円以上買えば送料無料なのと、どの商品買ってもSHEINっていう1つのショップだからお店ごとの送料とかないのが推しポイント。
しかも2000円でもアクセサリーとかネイルパーツなら大量に買い込めるくらい安い。

お洋服買いたい人はレビューしっかり見た方が良さそう。質感とか丈感とかで失敗してる人が多いイメージ。
アクセサリーはレビューないものでも、私が買ったものはしっかりしたのが届いた。
あとマイナスレビュー書いてる人に結構いるのが、サイズが思ったより〇〇ってやつ。サイズはサイズガイドチェックしてから買うのが吉。

コスプレやってる人とハンドメイドやってる人におすすめしたい。
キャラウィッグ風のものが安く売ってたり、衣装作ったりアレンジしたりする時に使える小物が豊富。
私は衣装のアレンジとか小物を作る材料を買ってるけど、安くて衣装のクオリティ上がるから最高。
質はそこそこだけどハンドメイドに必要な材料が安くて大容量だから、失敗しても凹まない。
ただネイルパーツとか〇〇個入りの表記があっても、少し足りなかったり多かったりする。

すぐ使う用事ではなくて、良質なものじゃなくても大丈夫で、数が足りなくてもまあいっかって思える人はハマると思う。
物にもよるけどお値段以上な物も結構あったり、お店とかで売られてるのと全く同じものが半額以下で売られてたりする。(800円だか900円で買ったかわいい靴下が300円くらいで売っててショック受けた)

I’ve found shein to be a great online shopping app, it’s the only one I use and I’ve downloaded tons. You can return most items such as clothing but not makeup and some jewellery obviously. Online payments which is good as it includes clear pay for uk residents of ur not willing to pay in full. And it’s so easy to track your parcels, as I’m writing this mine is in transit. Some deliveries do take a few days such as a week or two. But I’ve found small purchases come as quick as 5 days. It has everything you could wish for including points which u can log into the app daily to get them or enter clothing challenges etc to take money off your final purchase, coupons, TONS of them and so much more!
Overall I love this app and definitely recommend

title: The real facts about shien
content: Personally, I’ve always know kind of what my style was. It’s definitely more street wear-ish and I’ve never been able to find cloths that fit it exactly. But, shien literally has everything you’ll need and want, for both men and women, dogs, kids, and even some room decorations. If you’re thinking about getting shien for clothing definitely go for it. I heard some bad things about shien, like their cloths aren’t good, orders never showing, stuff like that. But I’ve never had a problem with it it. I’ve had cloths from shien for months now that are still in great condition, and are still my favorite clothing I own. Now, some of the fabrics are weird, and undesirable personally. I’ve ordered a few hoodies that look good, but I just personally am not a fan of the fabric. This is not the case with all clothing though. I have a lot of comfortable cloths from shien, that were super cheap. A ‘hual’ for me personally is typically 18 pieces of clothing or maybe a phone case or something and it’s usually around $130. Which is super cheap considering the pricing of cloths in stores. I’ve never had any problems with my orders and shipping either. Sometimes they ship some items separately from the others which it is what it is, but other than that delivery and packaging is great. I usually get all my things days before the estimated delivery time. The app is super easy to use, you’ll get a hang out it fairly quickly. They give you points which take a few dollars off of your order, and you’ll typically never go without a coupon. I haven’t. So if you’re thinking about getting shien, GO FOR IT CHILE ITS SO GOOD.

title: I wanna give five stars
content: I love so many things about SHEIN. I like to pronounce it, Shine! They always have my size which is usually hard to find. You can filter for better material quality if you’re like me and prefer/need natural fibres. The shipping and returns aren’t scammy like lots of other international companies. I find that if you follow their descriptions everything is generally spot on size wise, and it’s affordable for very poor people like me. Alas, I can’t give a full five bc of the unfair labour practices that keep being mentioned online. I also follow some tiktok creators who have had their designs stolen from SHEIN which isn’t cool. There could be more care for the environment. The shipping is pretty slow but tbh if it were faster in this current climate it’d only drive up the prices so I’m cool with planning ahead a bit. Lots to love and trust about SHEIN and they aren’t worse ethically than other high street brands but are cheaper and have my size so they beat the competition in many ways but definitely have some serious room for improvement. Trustworthy for actually getting what you ordered and being able to return it without much hassle which is pretty major.

title: Styling on a budget
content: I slick have a SHEIN addiction. There’s always ways to save money whether it be from checking in daily for reward points, frequent coupons they have, sales they always have and even writing reviews gains you points which is about as equivalent as a penny because every 100 points, it’s a dollar off. They usually always have a spend over a certain amount and get free express shipping. Over the past 6 months or so, they have really stepped their shipping game up. I’ve been getting my packages a few days earlier then estimated. Just like all online stores, you have to really read the reviews to know what you’re getting and because you do get points for putting up reviews you see a lot of I NEED POINTS PLEASSSSEEEE reviews, but there are some really helpful reviews in every item I’ve been interested in. Seeing how an item fits on someone who has similar measurements as you or seeing the fabric and how it lays on someone other than the model advertising it, is extremely helpful. You can buy literally anything on there from house storage supplies, makeup, shoes, jewelry, kids clothes, little Knick knacks, it’s pretty neat. I’ve only personally gotten clothes and recently some rings, so I can’t vouch on the Misc things they sell. But you can get some great high quality clothes and accessories. They also let you pay with after pay and a few other payment options so even if your cart is over $100, you really only need at least $25 give or take depending on the taxes and such, because at least with after pay, it’s broken down into a 4 payment plan that you pay every two weeks so it’s not a hard hit to the wallet immediately. I Hope this helps!

content: Such a huge selection of stunning dresses & lovely things. Easiest shopping site to navigate on the whole net. Has a better & more efficient built in search engine than Google. It’s my favourite place to buy dresses but there are cheaper sources for the exact same homeware & same cosmetic related products, the latter of which I wouldn’t buy as ALL Chinese cosmetics are tested on animals & in Labs with No Animal Welfare rules, checks, standards or limits.

content:

title: Wirklich tolle Sachen!
content: Man muss sich aber die Rezensionen anschauen, am besten mit Bildern. Meist ist’s aber genau wie beschrieben und wie auf dem Bild. Seit kurzem kann ich leider nicht mehr per Klarna Rechnung zahlen. Das ist echt ärgerlich, angeblich ein Systemfehler, den man schon vor Wochen beheben wollte. Was mir dabei aufgefallen ist: Zahlung per Vorkasse dauert beim Rückerstattungsprozess viel länger, heißt: die arbeiten mit dem Geld. Bei Rechnung wurde diese oder die zurück gesendeten Artikel schon bei Aufgabe des Paketes sofort  erstattet  oder storniert. Wenn man schon bezahlt hat, brauchen die länger, angeblich sind es ja so viele Pakete, das kann dauern. Da frag ich mich, warum das nur Verzögerung bei Vorkasse gibt. Nun ja summa summarum ist’s aber ein toller online Shop, Versand dauert meist 12-18 Tage (Ware kommt ja auch aus China). Rücksendung ist problemlos und kostenlos (eine kostenlose Rücksendung pro Bestellung). Die Größen stimmen auch oft überein (immer die Bewertungen zu den Artikeln lesen).

title: 大人のサンホみたい
content:
インスタ広告で気になる服があって初めて利用してみました。
海外通販サイトはハンドメイドの物で利用したことがありましたが、sheinはその半分以下の日数で届いたと思います。
梱包は国内通販のように丁寧ではないです。
大きな袋で届きましたが何箇所か穴が…笑
商品は個包装で緩衝材などは入っておらず、プラスチックの大きいボトルとか頼んでたので割れてないか心配でした。大丈夫でしたが！
あと入力した住所は合ってるはずなのに表示されたお届け先は地区名が抜けていて、とりあえず届くのを待っていたら佐川急便から住所分からないと電話が来ました。
配達員さんには住所間違ってたみたいで、すみません！と言われましたがどこで変わっちゃったんだろう…

届いた服自体はかわいいけど値段相応って感じでした。トップス正面の生地にヨレ？癖？がついていて取れない😭生地も薄めでしたが夏服なので涼しくて良いのかもしれん。
ちなみに服は色々見た感じ、春夏服だからか肩腹脚出しが多かったです。
露出多めのぴったりめの服が好きな人は特に向いてそう。
流行りの腹チラ服可愛いのたくさんありましたが胃腸が雑魚なので諦めました…
他にも雑貨など注文してみました。
細々した雑貨は見るだけで楽しくて、昔やってたサ○宝石を思い出しました笑

title: If you want cheap, great quality clothes, look here.
content: I have never been so impressed with a clothing company. I am a straight up broke senior in highschool and I bought my graduation dress for $15 and it’s gotten way more compliments than everyone else’s $200 dress from other places. I’ve ordered a few times I’m almost certain it’s 8 times but possibly more. Each time I had 10 plus items ordered and only once have I ever been disappointed which was on my own dumb self. If you’re trying to see if this is a good app or if it’s trustworthy, the only thing you have to worry about is the sizes. Which can be fixed by simply reading the reviews. I tend to go with the ones with over a hundred reviews so I know it’s been tested by people like me🤣 overall, I’ve never had a bad experience with shein even the send back process is phenomenal I can’t even explain how painless it was. As well as how great quality for such a low price. Don’t be frightened off by low prices if you feel like more expensive fabric is important to you, they have that too. I ordered a bridesmaid dress for $70 and it is SO NICE. Better than my $300 prom dress from a wedding shop. I recommend to my grave.

title: SHEIN is Semi-size inclussive
content:
As a senior in High School whk makes maybe $500 a month this all has saved me MANY times from spend $30 on a plus size t-shirt. There’s lot of options when it comes to plus size clothing, however, the “regular sized” clothing has almost THOUSANDS of options. Many of those not even being able to be considered possible to be worn by plus size women. I think I’ve seen a few clothing items in regular section they may have reach the two smallest sizes available for plus size clothing. Most of them are.. and when I say tiny… I mean SMALL. I myself am usually a size 16-20 depending on the brand, stretch, fit etc. I don’t usually even have to find a plus size section in more off brand stores like Walmart or Ross. But on SHEIN I absolutely have to size 1-2 times depending on the product. Sizing up isn’t the issue, the only issue I’m finding is while, yes, there are lots and lots of options for plus size people
To shop, the Non-plus size section blows us out of the water. Not only in amount but by cuteness. If that makes sense at all? Some of the clothes in the plus size section make me feel like a 30yr old woman. Where as I’d feel more confident in something I would find in the Non-plus size section of SHEIN.

title: Top Online Plus Size Clothing
content:
I love love love Shein. it’s a really good little app with a reward system in the form of points awarded for checking in, for confirming receipt of your order and for reviewing items. These points really add up and with the occasional free shipping that they offer it’s a great way to buy quality clothes on a budget. Plus Size clothing online varies from the wildly expensive to the late middle-aged and Shein is a welcome change to all this. Their jeans are fab, my only small issue is that the tops are sometimes made of a shiny material but this is just a small niggle.

Overall if you’re looking for fashionable plus size clothing on a budget then Shein is the place for you. And don’t even get me started on the Homewares section - I could get lost for days!

content: At the time of my first purchase I had only just become familiar with online shopping. And only used two websites that I was comfortable with. Coupons discounts free shipping all right up my alley. I’m very much into variety but not rich. The wide variety of products jewelry shoes clothes make up underwear swimwear the list goes on. All great. I look at cheaper items like this. If you love it great you didn’t spend a whole lot. If you don’t it’s okay you didn’t spend a whole lot. Maybe find someone to give it to. There’s really no losing. I bought so much so far I really am in trouble. But anywhere else I would have paid ten times more. I bought stuff for my Aunt. She was pleased with the shoes and purse. But the dress wasn’t quite what she wanted. Still going to find a use for it. This experience was better by far then it was bad. Warning! It is addictive! I think I need rehab lol! And it did not help they have tons of butterfly items. That is my groove thang. I’m butterfly all day.

title: Just about the only place I shop…
content: I first heard about SHEIN from my youngest daughter before she left home, she was still in high school and I thought it was just a site for young girls to shop.
